caption: The drawing shows a single goblet centered within a rectangular border. The goblet is rendered in grayscale, with shading to suggest a three-dimensional form and highlights to indicate a reflective surface. The goblet has a wide, slightly flared rim, a gently curving bowl that becomes narrower toward the base, and a short, ornate stem resting on a round, flat foot. In the upper left corner, there is a smaller inset drawing depicting the same goblet, but in outline with precise measurements (3 1/2 inches tall, 1 inch wide at the rim, 3/16 inches wide at the base). The artist’s name “EUGENE LAFORÊT.” is written in the bottom right corner of the rectangular border. The entire composition is on a light beige background, and the lines and shading are done in pencil or graphite.
title: Pewter Chalice
